summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Discord Detail View with all production-level features. All 8 features tested and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Discord Detail View correctly implements all production-level features as specified
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Save Configuration successfully calls backend API and shows success toast
Bot Active toggle correctly toggles between Active/Inactive states
Listen Mode buttons (Mention Only, All Channels, Specific Channels) are clickable and change selection with visual feedback
Reply Style buttons (Natural reply, With @mention) toggle correctly
Passive Mode and Scripted Mode toggles work correctly with visual state changes
Human Takeover section has all required inputs: Staff Role Name, Cooldown minutes, Resume Command (read-only), Follow-up Message
Currently in handoff indicator and Resume Bot Now button are visible
Telegram and Zendesk detail views show connection status and response mode badges correctly
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing API Tester bot with Discord, Telegram, and Zendesk connections
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discord Detail View fully tested with all production features. Key data-testid attributes verified: discord-detail-view, discord-app-setup-banner, discord-disconnect-btn, discord-setup-guide, discord-bot-status-card, discord-config-card, discord-active-toggle, discord-listen-mode-card, listen-mode-mention_only, listen-mode-all_channels, listen-mode-specific_channels, discord-reply-style-card, reply-style-natural, reply-style-mention, discord-passive-mode-card, toggle-passive-mode, discord-scripted-mode-card, toggle-scripted-mode, discord-human-takeover-card, staff-role-name, cooldown-minutes, follow-up-message, resume-bot-now, save-config-btn, start-bot-btn, back-to-integrations. Bot 'API Tester' has connections for all 3 providers.

features_tested.feature: Integrations page shows 3 provider cards (Discord, Telegram, Zendesk) with status badges and response mode info
features_tested.details: All 3 cards visible with correct status badges: Discord (Paused→Active after toggle), Telegram (Paused), Zendesk (Active). Response mode badges shown for connected providers.

features_tested.feature: Discord card opens DiscordDetail with all production-level features
features_tested.details: Discord Bot heading, Discord App Setup banner with Open link, Connect to Discord section with connection status and Disconnect button, Setup Guide with 3 numbered steps, Bot Status card, Configuration card with Bot Active toggle, Listen Mode picker, Reply Style picker, Passive Mode toggle, Scripted Mode toggle, Human Takeover section, Save Configuration button, Start Bot button - all visible and functional.

features_tested.feature: Listen Mode buttons are clickable and change active selection
features_tested.details: All 3 buttons (Mention Only, All Channels, Specific Channels) are clickable and change selection with blue border highlight.
Both buttons (Natural reply, With @mention) toggle correctly with visual feedback.

features_tested.feature: Passive Mode and Scripted Mode toggles change visually when clicked
features_tested.details: Both toggle switches change state visually when clicked (OFF→ON).

features_tested.feature: Save Configuration button calls backend and shows success toast
features_tested.details: Save Configuration button calls PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections/{conn_id} and shows 'Configuration saved' success toast.

features_tested.feature: Back to Integrations button returns to provider cards view
features_tested.details: Button works correctly and returns to the 3-card grid view.

features_tested.feature: Bot Active toggle calls toggle connection endpoint and updates UI
features_tested.details: Toggle changed from 'Inactive' to 'Active' state after clicking, confirming backend integration works.

features_tested.feature: Telegram detail view shows connection status and response mode badge
features_tested.details: Shows 'Bot connected' status (paused), Enable button, and Auto-Reply response mode badge.

features_tested.feature: Zendesk detail view shows connection status and response mode badge
features_tested.details: Shows 'Connected to midnight-gd.zendesk.com' status (active), Disable button, and Internal Note response mode badge.
